articles.title: Proxy firm IiAS faults Rahul Bhatia’s leadership as IndiGo faces turbulence
articles.summary: Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IiAS) has criticized IndiGo's promoter and managing director, Rahul Bhatia, for his perceived lack of proactive leadership. IiAS faulted Bhatia for 'not leading from the front' during a challenging period for the airline. This highlights ongoing corporate governance concerns and leadership accountability within a major Indian aviation company.
